gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-arimo: Arimo has a tall mean line and rounded glyphs whose terminals stay spacious, so text looks open and orderly. Stencilia, the display heading, adds a structural punch above it.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-atkinson-hyperle: Striking structure up top, friendly openness below. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next has lowercase eyes as big as washers, so a body size a notch up would let them show.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-carrois-gothic-s: Approachable describes Carrois Gothic SC, with clear curve openings. Stencilia does striking, structural work at display scale, while the body font quietly keeps capitals and lowercase close in height.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-chivo: Structural punch above, packed lowercase below. Stencilia is the one for striking display lettering, while Chivo is the sans-serif that lets daylight through every curve and stays easy going.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-comme: Comme reads smoothly, with no clogged curves and lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height. Over a whole page it feels modern and unfussy.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-cossette-texte: Cossette Texte gives each lowercase e a wide-eyed look and a prominent x-height, with n arches as thick as their stems. A whole page of it feels clean, unhurried and quiet.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-georama: Wide-open c, like a bracelet pulled apart. Georama's barely rising capitals sit low under Stencilia's structural, striking heading, so the sans text never competes with the display lettering.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-golos-text: Approachable is Golos Text, built from one width of stroke with a widely parted s. Golos Text is the pair's strongest quality: a plain stripe of constant ink under Stencilia's lively, structural display lettering.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-hind-madurai: Stencilia leaves spacious gaps at its curve terminals and a compact gap below the ascender line. Hind Madurai answers with parallel stroke edges and wide s curves, so lowercase fills the line like capitals.
gen-dafont-stencilia-gf-hind-mysuru: Striking up top, steady below. Hind Mysuru's diagonals are just as thick as its uprights, with no calligraphic thinning, which gives Stencilia's structural display lettering a sturdy, uniform partner.
